title: Unit normalization for ordinary constant pullback
statement:
Canonical section variables and instances are those of the attached Lean module.

theorem ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_hom_unit (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom ≫
        (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).hom =
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map
          (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).hom ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom

proof.text: Compose the proved ordinary-to-canonical constant comparison with the single-object unit map using congrArg. Apply the separately proved module-coefficient canonical unit square for the second equality. This preserves the ordinary definition and the X7 comparison equations.
